mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_task_claim ( task_type, target_id, operator_id, operator_name, operator_role, lock_token, claimed_at, expires_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{claim.taskType}, #{claim.targetId}, #{claim.operatorId}, #{claim.operatorName}, #{claim.operatorRole}, #{claim.lockToken}, #{claim.claimedAt}, #{claim.expiresAt}, #{claim.updatedAt} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE operator_id = IF(expires_at <= #{now} OR operator_id = #{claim.operatorId}, VALUES(operator_id), operator_id), operator_name = IF(expires_at <= #{now} OR operator_id = #{claim.operatorId}, VALUES(operator_name), operator_name), operator_role = IF(expires_at <= #{now} OR operator_id = #{claim.operatorId}, VALUES(operator_role), operator_role), lock_token = IF(expires_at <= #{now} OR operator_id = #{claim.operatorId}, VALUES(lock_token), lock_token), claimed_at = IF(expires_at <= #{now} OR operator_id = #{claim.operatorId}, VALUES(claimed_at), claimed_at), expires_at = IF(expires_at <= #{now} OR operator_id = #{claim.operatorId}, VALUES(expires_at), expires_at), updated_at = IF(expires_at <= #{now} OR operator_id = #{claim.operatorId}, VALUES(updated_at), updated_at)
